path_1_elevenlabs_deepgram.what_happened: ElevenLabs customer lines were generated without lead context and injected into the live Deepgram Voice Agent. Deepgram greeted, recorded consent, then handed off when the customer asked for a person.
path_1_elevenlabs_deepgram.elevenlabs_tts: 402 Payment Required on this account, so MP3 artifacts were not written. The customer still spoke to Deepgram via InjectUserMessage and Deepgram ConversationText.

path_3_twilio_deepgram.what_happened: Twilio REST accepted credentials and attempted an outbound call into the Deepgram media bridge. Trial accounts cannot dial unverified +61400000101.
path_3_twilio_deepgram.how_a_human_call_works: Point the Twilio number Voice webhook to PUBLIC_BASE_URL/api/voice/inbound. ConversationText streams to /api/live/{lead_id} and the dashboard Live transcript panels.
